newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Angping says PLDT a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Angping says PLDT a hold.

text.p: Angping Securities recommended a hold on Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) on Tuesday, saying investors should await a clearer picture on international call charges.
The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) has proposed a cut in international call charges, which will affect PLDT revenues. The cut in tariffs is yet to be finalised.

"The FCC previously said that it will work closely with PLDT on resolving an accounting rate acceptable for both parties; however, nothing is final yet. We advise investors to stay on the sidelines," analyst Alexis Cabel said in a report.
PLDT fell to a nine-month low of 1,365 pesos on Tuesday from 1,570 pesos in mid-December.
